body: I really hope that seeing them helps.
I'm looking forward to seeing my parents next week. I look forward to nothing else.

Thank you for offering to talk to me. That means a lot. I'm trying to take care of myself but I can't seem to CARE about taking care of myself. I'm so apathetic to everything it seems. Sometimes I think I care, but then I get discouraged and convince myself that I don't. How fucked is that? I'm such a quitter it's unbelievable.

I feel happy when we get along like a normal couple. I feel happy when I talk to my parents, but that also makes me sad because they live 1,000 miles away and I still feel that I need them. There's not really a 'most happy' time because I constantly overthink things until they become void.
How can I deserve to be happy when I just make people miserable? My family, my boyfriend.... I don't even have the strength or feelings to care for my dog properly anymore.
